use default
use Raster.ANIMATION
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

let size = 150
let frames = 72
let segments = 100

draw(image: IMAGE, increment: double) is
    image.clear(15ub, 15ub, 25ub)
    image.stroke(1.0D)

    let x mut = 0.0D
    let y mut = 0.0D
    let length mut = 5.0D
    let angle mut = increment

    for segment in 0..segments do
        let radians = angle * Math.pi / 180.0D
        let next_x = x + length * Math.cos(radians)
        let next_y = y + length * Math.sin(radians)
        let fade = cast double(segment) / cast double(segments)

        image.colour(
            cast ubyte(255.0D * (1.0D - fade)),
            cast ubyte(120.0D + 100.0D * fade),
            255ub)
        image.line(x, y, next_x, next_y)

        x = next_x
        y = next_y
        length = length + 3.0D
        angle = angle + increment
    od
si

let image = IMAGE(size, size)

image.view(-250.0D, -250.0D, 250.0D, 250.0D)

let animation = ANIMATION(size, size)

for frame in 0..frames do
    draw(image, 90.0D + 360.0D * cast double(frame) / cast double(frames))
    animation.add(image, 100)
od

write_line("{frames} spirals, the turn between segments going full circle")

animation.write("polyspiral.png")

animation.show("polyspiral.png")
